kamloops.title: 2026 BC Summer Games open in Kelowna under smoke warning
kamloops.description: Despite an air quality warning, organizers decided the Games could continue safely on Friday morning, after consulting with Environment Canada and closely monitoring conditions

cariboo.title: ‘It was difficult’: Residents of Clinton, B.C. recount evacuating wildfires
cariboo.description: Wildfires burning across British Columbia have forced residents from communities including Clinton and Boston Bar, with many unsure if they'll have homes to return to.

cariboo.title: B.C. community’s water system damaged by alleged vandalism during wildfire response
cariboo.description: Police are investigating after the water system serving the evacuated B.C. community of Boston Bar was allegedly vandalized, potentially delaying residents' return home.

all.description: Air quality levels are forecast to drop to unhealthy levels across the U.S. Midwest and Northeast on Tuesday as smoke from Canadian wildfires intensifies. AirNow’s Fire and Smoke Map showed the regions blanketed in yellow due to the drifting smoke. all.title: ‘I’m not leaving’: Some B.C. residents vow to defend homes from wildfires
all.description: As wildfires intensify across Canada, a transportation expert says governments need a national firefighting strategy focused on prevention instead of evacuation.
